svg.text: Figure 4-1 · The cybersecurity requirements and where each stands
The 64 requirements of §4 in their sixteen groups, each with its allocation and status: 7 in place, 16 partly, 34 not met, 7 not determined; none verified
Release panda firmware for the reference configuration shall
accept a car safety mode only if model, parameter and
alternative experience equal the compile-time locked values
A rejected safety-configuration request shall leave the
panda in a non-actuating mode and set a fault flag reported
to the SoC in the health packet.
Transitions from the locked car mode to SILENT or
NOOUTPUT shall remain permitted at all times.
While a car safety mode is active, release firmware shall
reject host commands outside a documented allow-list,
including relay drive (0xc5), CAN mode/speed changes
Alternative experience shall not be changeable in release
pandad shall compare the panda-reported safety model,
parameter and alternative experience with the release-record
values and prevent engagement and raise an alert on
CSR-C-02 No debug capability in release firmware
The release panda firmware and bootstub shall be built with
RELEASE and the LionDriver certificate, and the release
build shall fail if ALLOW_DEBUG is defined.
The release bootstub shall not contain the debug public key
and shall accept no key other than the LionDriver release
mode, bootloader entry, debug sleep) shall be absent from
Softloader entry (0xd1 param 1) shall be accepted only while
the panda is in a non-actuating mode and the vehicle ignition
The bootstub shall verify the application image with an
ECDSA signature over P-256 and a SHA-256 digest (128-bit
security strength; decided 2026-10-19, DQ-191 A) before
The verifying public key shall be the LionDriver panda
release key, whose private key is generated and held offline
and never stored in the repository, CI or logs.
The bootstub shall reject an image whose version is below a
minimum version held in write-protected storage.
The application image integrity shall be re-checked at
start-up and periodically at run time, with mismatch leading
The panda option bytes shall be set at provisioning to an
RDP level chosen by CS-AD-02 that prevents read-out and
Write protection shall be set on the bootstub sector(s) so
that neither the application nor the softloader can modify
Installation shall record the option-byte values and the
bootstub and application hashes, and compare them with the
Release pandad shall not flash a development bootstub;
recovery shall flash only the release-signed bootstub and
SoC use of STM_BOOT0 for recovery shall occur only on
explicit offroad owner action and shall be logged as a
pandad shall not set a car safety mode unless the panda
reports the firmware version and signature recorded in the
The architecture shall prevent SoC control of
STM_BOOT0/STM_RST_N from resulting in execution of
firmware not signed with the LionDriver release key, or the
residual shall be recorded as a cybersecurity claim per…
The panda envelope limits and checks shall not depend on
any value from the SoC params store or msgq other than the
Safety-relevant params (§3.8) shall be writable only by their
designated writer processes, enforced by OS file
permissions, and their values shall be checked against the
release record at manager start with engagement blocked on…
Each safety-relevant msgq topic consumed by controlsd,
selfdrived, plannerd or dmonitoringd shall be publishable only
by its designated process, and a second publisher shall be
webrtcd, UI) shall run without permission to write
safety-relevant params or publish safety-relevant topics.
Release builds shall not start the joystick,
The release build check shall fail if any developer-mode
entry point is reachable in the release configuration.
modeld and dmonitoringmodeld shall load model artefacts and
metadata without deserializing executable objects (no pickle
Before loading, every model artefact shall be verified against
a SHA-256 hash in the authenticated release manifest, and
the process shall refuse to run on mismatch so that
Model artefacts shall be fetched from LionDriver-controlled
storage and their hashes recorded in the release record.
Panda firmware shall verify every checksum and counter that
the vehicle provides on safety-relevant RX messages, and
shall cross-check messages that carry none (brake 0x226,
wheel speed 0xAA) for plausibility against independent…
Panda firmware shall transmit only allow-listed actuation
messages on the car-side bus and shall not alter
Reception on the car-side bus of an actuation message ID
that the panda transmits, while the relay intercepts, shall be
detected and lead to actuation inhibit.
LionDriver installer and image builds shall not contain an
embedded authorized SSH key or set SshEnabled.
SshEnabled shall be false in the reference configuration and
When the owner enables SSH, only key authentication with
SSH shall not accept new sessions while the vehicle is
athenad shall not run in the reference configuration unless
If enabled, file uploads requested over athena shall go only
to allow-listed destination hosts over TLS with certificate
If enabled, the SSH-tunnel and authorized-key RPCs shall
If enabled, getMessage shall serve only allow-listed,
Release builds shall ignore the ATHENA_HOST environment
Onroad camera streaming shall remain impossible, and
webrtcd shall bind only to the loopback interface.
No safety function shall depend on athena or any back-end
The updater shall stage an update only after verifying a
LionDriver-signed release manifest (§3.6) and every artefact
against it; the manifest signature uses the firmware scheme,
ECDSA over P-256 with SHA-256 (DQ-191 A), with the…
Release builds shall fix the update origin and accept only
The updater shall reject a manifest whose release version is
lower than the installed one unless the manifest is a signed
Until CSR-121 is implemented, DisableUpdates shall be set
in the reference configuration and updates installed manually
Update installation shall be offroad-only and atomic, with the
previous release remaining bootable if finalization fails.
The update-signing key shall be distinct from the panda
release key, held offline, and covered by a re-keying
All submodules shall point to LionDriver-controlled forks and
No release dependency or tool shall be resolved from a
mutable reference (branch or tag without hash).
Every release shall have an SBOM covering uv.lock
packages, submodule commits, LFS artefacts, AGNOS
version and images, comma-deps wheels and the panda
Every release and the current release weekly shall be
scanned against public vulnerability data, with each finding
Release signing material shall never be available to CI jobs
triggered from pull requests or forks.
CSR-C-14 Personal data and identity key
The device identity private key shall be readable only by the
processes that sign with it and shall not be exposed through
Driver-facing video, cabin imagery and location logs shall be
encrypted at rest, or, if AGNOS cannot provide this,
driver-camera recording shall be off by default and retention
Any data upload shall use TLS with certificate validation to
Driver-camera video shall not be uploaded unless the owner
The decommissioning procedure shall erase user data and
Decommissioning shall revoke the device's credentials at
every LionDriver endpoint and remove owner SSH keys.
LionDriver shall publish a security policy with a private
Vulnerability analysis, incident response and update
management shall run per WP-O-05 from G6.

g.text: Terms: AGNOS the comma device's operating system · CAL cybersecurity assurance level, 1 to 4 (ISO/SAE 21434) · CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus · CI continuous integration: the checks that run on

every pull request · CS-nn cybersecurity architecture decision CS-AD-nn (WP-S-07 §3.4) · CSG-nn cybersecurity goal (WP-C-10) · CSR-nn cybersecurity requirement: CSR-C-nn at concept level (WP-C-10 §7), CSR-nnn

refined (WP-S-07) · DQ-nn decision of the project lead (decision register) · ECDSA elliptic-curve digital signature algorithm · ENV build and release environment (allocation class, WP-S-07 §2) · FW firmware · ID

identifier · IPC inter-process communication · LFS Git Large File Storage (where the model files live) · NOOUTPUT the panda's safety mode that receives but sends nothing · OS-nn operational situation (HARA §3) ·

P-256 the NIST elliptic curve used with ECDSA (128-bit security) · PCS pre-collision system: Toyota's stock collision warning and braking · RDP read-out protection of the MCU's flash (option bytes) · RPC remote

procedure call · RX receive · SBOM software bill of materials: the list of every component and version · SHA-256 a cryptographic hash used to identify a file exactly · SILENT the panda's safety mode that sends

nothing · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · SSH secure shell (remote login) · TLS transport layer security: encrypted network connections · UI user interface: the

device's screen · UPD-nn update procedure step (WP-O-02) · USR owner, installer or maintainer acting under a procedure (allocation class) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C
concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
